title: How to play
subtitle: One board a day. Every try deals its own pieces. Best of 3 tries counts.
status_note: Ticket sales aren't open yet. Adventure mode is free and open now.
tut_desc: A real board with three short goals. Drag the piece, tap a spot, or use the arrow keys and Enter.
tut_a_hint: Put the square on any empty spot. Anywhere it fits is fine.
tut_a_done: That is a whole move. Pieces stay where you drop them, and they never rotate.
tut_a_miss: Placed. On to the next one.
tut_b_hint: The bottom row has three gaps. Fill them with the bar to clear the row.
tut_b_done: A full row disappears and scores points. Full columns work the same way.
tut_b_miss: It landed, but the row is still open. Press Retry and aim for the three gaps in the bottom row.
tut_c_hint: This corner piece can finish a row and a column in one move. Find the spot.
tut_c_done: Two lines at once is a combo. Each line in it is worth 1.5 times a single clear, and bigger combos pay more.
tut_c_miss: Close. The bottom row and the right edge are both missing the same corner.
tut_no_fit: It does not fit there. Every block of the piece needs an empty cell.
tut_piece_label: Practice piece. Drag it onto the board, or press Enter and then use the arrow keys.
tut_keys: Keyboard: arrow keys move, Enter places.
adventure_desc: A map of levels to practice on. No tickets, no prizes. Play as much as you like.
daily_ranked_desc: 1 ticket = 1 USDC = 1 attempt. Up to 3 attempts per wallet per UTC day, and your best one counts. The top 10 each day and each month win USDC.
board_desc: 64 cells. You place pieces one at a time.
pieces_desc: Pick a piece, then tap where it goes. Pieces don't rotate. In Ranked the server deals the pieces, so nobody sees the next ones early.
clear_desc: A full row or column clears. Clear more than one at once for a combo. Blocks don't fall after a clear.
end_desc: The run ends when none of your pieces fit anywhere.
fair_desc: Before each UTC day starts, a fingerprint of that day's seed (a sha256 commitment) is published. After the day ends, the seed and every move of every run are published, so anyone can re-check every score.
split_explain: Each 1 USDC ticket is split on-chain, inside the purchase transaction:
vault_desc: Pays the daily and monthly top 10.
referrer_desc: The wallet whose link you came from. No referrer? This 5% goes to the team, so the team gets 30%.
when_you_win: If you finish in the top 10
win_daily: Results are posted on-chain after each UTC day, and after each month.
win_block: The team then has 24 hours to block a result it finds fraudulent.
win_claim: After that, you claim your USDC straight from the prize program with your wallet.
win_unclaim: Prizes not claimed within 90 days go back to the pool.
prizes_intro: Every ticket puts 0.70 USDC into the prize vault. That money pays two contests: one for each UTC day and one for each month. Each pays its top 10.
prizes_daily_desc: 40% of what the vault takes in during a UTC day, paid to that day's top 10.
prizes_monthly_desc: The other 60%, collected over the whole month and paid to the month's top 10.
prizes_curve_desc: Both pots use the same curve. First place takes a quarter, and every rank down to 10th gets paid.
prizes_blocks_note: Each block is 1% of the pot.
prizes_calc_daily: {tickets} tickets a day put {vault} USDC in the vault each day. {pot} USDC of it goes to that day's top 10.
prizes_calc_monthly: Keep that up for 30 days and the monthly pot reaches {pot} USDC.
prizes_example_note: These amounts are examples. The real pots depend on how many tickets sell.
prizes_month_desc: Your monthly score is your 10 best daily scores added together. Play more than 10 days and your weaker days drop out. Play fewer and every day you played counts.
prizes_month_example: An example month with 13 days played. The 10 best days count.
risk_1_desc: Nobody outside the team has reviewed BlockBite's Solana program yet. Only spend what you can afford to lose.
risk_2_title: A ticket is spent when you start
risk_2_desc: Each attempt uses one ticket. If you don't finish in the top 10, you get nothing back.
risk_3_desc: A prize depends on your rank and on the result passing the 24-hour check.
risk_4_desc: Paid skill contests follow different rules in different countries. Check yours. 18+ only.
q_skill_desc: Your score comes from where you place pieces, and pieces are dealt fairly from a seed committed before the day starts and published after. Some countries still have special rules for paid contests, so check yours. 18+ only.
q_disconnect_desc: The ticket was spent when the attempt started. The server saves every move as you play, and when the UTC day ends the score you reached stands.
q_ticket_desc: No. One ticket is one attempt.
q_referral_desc: Your link is /r/ followed by your wallet address. When someone opens it and then buys tickets in that browser, 5% of their ticket money goes to your wallet in the same transaction.
q_open_desc: Once the prize program is live on Solana mainnet. Until then the ticket page says "Opening soon".
ready_desc: Adventure is free. Ranked opens when ticket sales do.
